subject: Nimbla: validation & onboarding sync
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@nimbla.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@nimbla.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbla: validation & onboarding sync

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed, lightweight validation plan so we can align on success criteria, data gating, and owners before we kick off: 

High-level success criteria
- Baseline latency: < 250ms p95 on representative request mix
- Retrieval accuracy: top-5 rerank relevance > 78% on the supplied test set
- Cost per 1k tokens within the target band you shared (~$0.45) under expected QPS
- No production security blockers (IP allowlist + hashed logs accepted)

Proposed 6-week timeline (compressed, with readouts):
- Week 0 (Oct 6) — Kickoff + access handoff; runbook & data gating checklist (30–60 min)
- Week 1 — Integration & baseline runs (tokenization checks, prefix caching)
- Week 2–3 — Quality iterations (prompt/temperature, quantization profile trials)
- Week 4 — Load/latency soak + cost tuning (batching/caching)
- Week 6 — Final readout + decision pass (customer signoff)

Proposed owners
- Redwood: Olga (PoV lead), Marissa (CS lead), Rishi (SRE/ops)
- Nimbla: Samir (product/data lead), Priya (security/compliance)

Open asks for your team before kickoff
1) Confirm you can provide a 7–14 day sample of hashed query logs (no PII) and the internal test set we discussed.
2) Provide IP ranges for allowlist or let us know if you want to use a VPN tunnel.
3) Confirm a single point of contact for infrastructure access.

Attachments: Nimbla_Redwood_PoV_Checklist.xlsx; week0-kickoff-agenda.pdf (see attached)

If that looks good I'll schedule the kickoff for Tue Oct 6 (30 min) and kick off calendar invites.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Shah <samir@nimbla.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@nimbla.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbla: validation & onboarding sync

Thanks, Olga — this is very helpful. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Data: we can provide a 14-day window of hashed query logs (SHA256). We will scrub any user-identifiable fields before export. Expect delivery by Oct 5.
- Security: IP allowlist is preferred; we'll provide our ingress ranges. We cannot do VPN tunnels for this PoV due to corporate policy.
- Timeline: the 6-week cadence looks OK but we have an internal demo sprint the week of Oct 20 that will reduce availability. If possible we prefer the final readout the week of Nov 9 (i.e., push final sync by one week).
- Compliance: we need confirmation of retention controls (ability to drop PoV data after completion) and a high-level statement on where logs are stored (region).

We can commit Samir and Priya as primary contacts. I'll confirm the log export by EOD Oct 5.

Cheers,
Samir
Director, Product — Nimbla Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbla: validation & onboarding sync

Looping Rishi in to own infra/access and adding a quick GDPR gating pass. Rishi — can you confirm the following before kickoff?

1) PoV environment will be provisioned in eu-west1 (logs remain in EU) — is that feasible?
2) We will expose a short retention workflow to delete the PoV dataset on completion; I can draft the language for Priya to approve.
3) I will take point on scheduling weekly 30-min checkpoints; Olga will run tech syncs and Rishi will handle access issues.

If Rishi can confirm items 1–2 by Mon Oct 5 we can lock the Oct 6 kickoff.

--
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@nimbla.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@nimbla.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbla: validation & onboarding sync

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and updated schedule below based on your availability notes:

Updated timeline
- Tue Oct 6 — Kickoff (30 min): access handoff, review checklist, confirm contacts
- Week 1 (Oct 6–13) — integration & baseline runs (Olga, Samir)
- Week 2–3 (Oct 13–27) — quality iterations (prompt tuning, small-profile quant)
- Week 4 (Oct 27–Nov 3) — soak + perf tuning
- Week 6 (Nov 9) — Final readout (live demo + decision)

I've attached the kickoff agenda and the PoV checklist; calendar invites are sent (see link below). Rishi confirmed EU hosting and an automatic 30-day retention policy for PoV logs that we can delete on request — Priya, we'll include the deletion acceptance in the final sign-off doc.

Access items outstanding (action owners):
- Samir: deliver hashed query logs by Oct 5 (Samir)
- Priya: IP ranges + any legal constraints for connectivity (Priya)
- Rishi: temporary SRE runbook for escalation during soak (Rishi)
- Marissa/Olga: weekly checkpoints (calendar invites)

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Nimbla-PoV

If this aligns I'll mark the kickoff as confirmed and we can proceed.

Best,
Olga
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Desai <priya@nimbla.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@nimbla.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbla: validation & onboarding sync

Thanks, Olga — that works for us. I shared IP ranges via secure link and confirmed the hashed logs export will be in our S3 staging bucket (credentials in a separate email). We will review the deletion language and aim to approve it by Nov 10.

See you at the kickoff on Oct 6.

— Priya
Head of Security & Compliance | Nimbla Inc.
